items.text: Suppose you are Salam. The day before yesterday you celebrated your 14th birthday. Your uncle sent you a nice gift. Write an email to your uncle thanking him for the gift.
items.explanation:
Sample email (addresses are examples):
To: uncle@example.com
From: salam@example.com
Subject: Thank you for the birthday gift

Dear Uncle,

Thank you very much for the thoughtful gift you sent for my fourteenth birthday. I was delighted to receive it, and your kindness made the celebration even more special. We missed you at the party and hope you can visit us soon. Please give my love to everyone at home.

With love,
Salam

items.text: Suppose you are Amina. Write an informal email to your friend Rina about what you did during an earthquake.
items.explanation:
Sample email (addresses are examples):
To: rina@example.com
From: amina@example.com
Subject: A message from Amina

Dear Rina,

Yesterday I felt the floor shake while I was reading at home. I moved away from the window, took cover under a sturdy table and protected my head. After the shaking stopped, we went outside by the stairs. Everyone in my family was safe, but the experience reminded us to practise a safety plan. What safety rules does your family follow?

With love,
Amina

If you develop a high fever, tell an adult and consult a qualified doctor. Never take medicine without proper advice. I hope you will share these precautions with our family too.

With love,
Amina
